speaker: john_florio
text: Master Shakespeare? Florio. From my lord's house in Holborn, and the house is in black.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear you, sir. Say it plain. A long sentence is no kindness to a jaw.

speaker: john_florio
text: Sir Thomas Heneage died this day at the Savoy. Vice-Chamberlain, Treasurer of the Chamber, and husband these eighteen months to my lord's mother.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sorry for the house.

speaker: john_florio
text: My lord is with her. There is a remedy for everything but death. I will not make you hold the other tongue tonight. It says the same.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I send my duty to my lord, and I ask nothing.

speaker: john_florio
text: That is proper, and it is as much as the house can carry tonight.

speaker: john_florio
text: A widow must first cast up a dead man's accounts. After that, who knows? Chi vive, vedrà.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the accounts come before any name. I will not pretend I have lost a friend. A name has gone off a paper. That is what I have lost.

speaker: john_florio
text: Nor will anyone here pretend it. I have not forgotten the Chaucer. I will send it when the house is quieter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The book can wait on the house. The duty I have already said.
